mods.name: Dolphin Fix
mods.description: Stops dolphins from drowning when out of simulation distance

releases.notes:
- Updated for 1.26.1.x

- Added a prevention for dolphins drying out while unable to move or even worse case when hovering midair after being unsimulated mid-jump

- Added a safety air replenish that should near completely reduce any accidental chip damage from if a dolphin is rapidly in then out the drowning/dryout twilight zone

- Added a config to enable/disable the drowning and dryout prevention separately as well as to adjust the simulation distance tolerance and the amount of safety air

readmeSummary: What it do: ============ Prevents dolphins from drowning (vers 1.2.0+: dryout as well) when out of simulation distance.
